item.title: Grace 0.3.1
item.description:
A friendlier Add from YouTube.

  • Paste any YouTube link: Grace works out whether it's a video or a playlist. Links that include a playlist show the playlist.
  • A YouTube link you've just copied is filled in for you.
  • Videos are previewed with their thumbnail, title and channel before downloading, and appear under their title while they download.
  • Playlists load on their own and show each video's length.
  • The dialog says which playlist the downloads join and that they are saved as MP3 in Music.
